incidents.name: Aztec Connect RollupProcessorV3 numRealTxs settlement gap
incidents.notes: Decoder.decodeProof() proves whole 32-tx inner-rollup chunks while processDepositsAndWithdrawals() settles only numRealTxs txs, and numRealTxs sits outside the hashed header, so a deposit in a later slot of the deprecated permissionless RollupProcessorV3 was minted on L2 without its L1 deposit ever being debited.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0xFF1F2B4ADb9dF6FC8eAFecDcbF96A2B351680455 created 2022-06-07 by 0xa173bddf4953c1e8be2ca0695cfc07502ff3b1e7, three EIP-1967 Upgraded events, last 2024-04-09 to impl 0x7d657ddcf7e2a5fd118dc8a6ddc3dc308adc2728; 14 chained rollups ids 13277-13290

incidents.name: Aztec V1 rollup escape hatch
incidents.notes: The permissionless escapeHatch() path accepted Turbo-PLONK proofs whose published inner proof_id was left unconstrained by the circuit, so a proof authorising a withdrawal with no matching deposit passed TurboVerifier and drained the rollup's pooled ETH, DAI and renBTC.
